purpose: Determine whether genuine fresh-context Opus-5 judgements contain a material behavioural residual relative to the frozen E0 deterministic reference before paying for larger AS2 execution.

selection.unit: one 32-archetype batch among B01..B08 per anonymous election-territory pair

residual_gate.unit_of_analysis: condition-cell aggregate of the selected 32-archetype cluster
residual_gate.reference: paired Opus-5 minus E0 on the exact same selected work item

primary_metrics.mean_cell_party_l1: L1 distance between Opus and E0 mean party simplexes within each selected work item, averaged across the 368 cells
primary_metrics.mean_cell_turnout_abs_delta: absolute difference between Opus and E0 mean turnout within each selected work item, averaged across the 368 cells
primary_metrics.cell_top_party_change_rate: share of the 368 selected condition-cells whose aggregate top party differs between Opus and E0

bootstrap.resampling_unit: anonymous election-territory pair carrying both opaque conditions

decision_rule.ADVANCE_AS2: at least one point estimate meets or exceeds its materiality threshold
decision_rule.KILL_AS2_EXPANSION: all three 95% upper confidence bounds are strictly below their thresholds
decision_rule.BLOCKED: execution contract, identity, completeness or schema validation fails

after_advance.preferred_next_step: collect a second independently frozen batch per anonymous election-territory pair or execute the full AS2 protocol; choice must be frozen before opening 2016
after_advance.social_layer_note: because social edges are confined to a voter batch/work item, the same cluster-sampling design can estimate Opus-vs-E0 social residuals without cross-cluster contamination
